title: Valid Elements in an Array
goal: Solve Valid Elements in an Array: Compare exclusive left and right maxima to keep valid elements in their original order.
strategy: Compare exclusive left and right maxima to keep valid elements in their original order.

phasePurposes.left: Track the largest value strictly before each index.
phasePurposes.right: Track the largest value strictly after each index.
phasePurposes.select: Keep values that beat at least one side.

edgeCases: A value qualifies by beating all values on either side, not necessarily both; equality fails the strict comparison.
inputRules: Enter a JSON array of 1–100 integers, each between 1 and 100.
